description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4320015121274 SEAL ASSEMBLY,SHAFT: Line 0001 Qty 14 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0193 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 2. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved source is 71431 630587-123N-1.87-CB/TC-EP. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
